Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Minion A with bleeds Meth B. Minion B blocks. Minion A Majesties to
S:CE and untap, then taps ambulance. Minion A does not need to tap
again to continue the action, and can now continue the action as an
untapped minion, correct?

We were discussing this on UIRC last night - you can also (I think)

Ambulance is going to be a lot of fun..

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The Psyche! window is before the Ambulance window.

After the Psyche! combat, you can tap the Ambulance.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Anthony Coleman wrote:
> I'm not sure you can - as I understand it the second combat is a
> seperate event. So the ambulance doesnt remember what the action was,
> as it were, as there was no action before the combat (just another
> combat)

The Psyche! combat is part of the action. The combatants are the acting minion
and the blocking minion (as required by Ambulance), so no problem there.

Messages.Author: Petri Wessman
Messages.Body:


...which brings up a cornercase scenario that I'm not sure about. What
about the following:

Meth A's Vampire A with Ambulance bleeds Meth B's Vampire B. B blocks
successfully, and plays Blissful Agony to send A off to fight Vampire
C (controlled by a third meth). Can A use the Ambulance after the
combat is over, or does the fact that the combat was "bounced" to a
third (non-blocking) minion disallow it? I guess it boils down to
whether you need to use the Ambulance directly after combat ends
between acting and blocking, or if there can be a combat "in between",
as part of the same action resolution.

//Petri
